description: A gray plastic tub sits in the center of the table, with a small yellow cup of ice to the left and a purple dustpan and brush to the right. The left hand reaches forward to grasp the yellow cup, lifts it up and slightly right over the tub, then tilts it to dump several ice cubes into the tub before rotating the cup upright again and moving it back left to set it down; the right hand stays near the dustpan without touching anything.
